description: This file defines a Kivy-based GUI application for code editing with syntax highlighting, key bindings, and file management features. It includes class definitions for dialogs, a custom CodeInput widget with Emacs key bindings, and the main application class.

classes.name: Fnt_SpinnerOption
classes.description: Custom spinner option class, inherits from SpinnerOption.

classes.name: LoadDialog
classes.description: Popup dialog for loading files, with load and cancel methods.

classes.name: SaveDialog
classes.description: Popup dialog for saving files, with save and cancel methods.

classes.name: CodeInputWithBindings
classes.description: Custom CodeInput widget with Emacs key bindings support.

classes.name: CodeInputTest
classes.description: Main application class for the code editor GUI, manages UI components and interactions.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads selected file into the dialog and updates window title.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves current text to the selected file and updates window title.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Constructs the main UI layout, including menus, code input, and bindings.

methods.name: _update_size
methods.description: Updates font size of the code input.

methods.name: _update_font
methods.description: Updates font name of the code input.

methods.name: _file_menu_selected
methods.description: Handles file menu actions: open, save, save as, close.

methods.name: _bindings_selected
methods.description: Sets key bindings mode based on user selection.

methods.name: on_files
methods.description: Loads file content into the code input when a file is selected.

methods.name: change_lang
methods.description: Changes syntax highlighting lexer based on selected language.
